sharedInstructions: Source: https://thenewrink.com/ (WordPress, preserve mode). Shared content config: src/content.config.ts with collections blog and docs (glob loaders on src/content/blog and src/content/docs). The blog schema already declares title, description, pubDate, draft, imageAlt, jsonLd, toc, featured, series and related display fields. No src/content/ entries were created for this import. Article layouts: src/layouts/BlogLayout.astro (default data-mdx-type blog) and src/layouts/DocsLayout.astro. The blog archive route is src/pages/blog.astro. Evidence: the WordPress posts endpoint returns only three posts (learn-to-rollerblade-5-week-beginner-classes-in-shelby-township, 7-health-benefits-of-roller-skating-for-kids-and-families, the-new-rink-shelby-township-your-familys-complete-guide-to-indoor-roller-skating), and none of them matches a requested path. Every requested source URL is either a WordPress page (wp-singular page-template-default, or the events landing for /schedule/friday/) or a 404 at source. No requested path is an individual article, so no article route, catch-all or content mapping was added and no targetPath is needed. Each entry is type page. Source paths /activity/<slug>/ redirect to /activities/<slug>/ on the source site; the existing template files are under src/pages/activities/. The schedule/friday source redirects to /events/friday-family-fun-nights/, which exists as src/pages/events/friday-family-fun-nights.astro. Requested paths that return 404 at source (schedule Saturday, Thursday, Sunday, Wednesday, Skate Rental; the faq question paths) have no content to import. The page worker should verify each one and must not invent content, and should decide whether to keep a neutral not-found page or a redirect. Use local paths for all internal navigation links. Keep external booking links (thenewrink.pcsparty.com) and tel:/mailto: links unchanged. Unresolved for the page worker: whether /activity/<slug>/ requests should render the page or redirect to /activities/<slug>/, and whether /schedule/friday/ should render or redirect to /events/friday-family-fun-nights/.
